Help.title: Help Center
Help.metaDescription: Get help with FoodShare - FAQs, guides, and support for sharing food in your community.
Help.qCreateAccount: How do I create an account?
Help.aCreateAccount: Click the "Sign Up" button and register with your email or social account. Complete your profile to start sharing food with your community.
Help.aShareFood: Click the "+" button to create a new listing. Add photos, description, pickup location, and availability. Your listing will appear on the map for nearby users.
Help.qFindFood: How do I find food near me?
Help.aFindFood: Use the interactive map to browse available food in your area. You can filter by food type, distance, and availability. Tap on a listing to see details and contact the sharer.
Help.aWhatFood: Share surplus food that is still safe to eat - unopened packaged goods, fresh produce, home-cooked meals, and baked goods. Always be honest about ingredients and preparation date.
Help.aMessage: Open a listing and tap "Message" to start a chat with the sharer. Use chat to coordinate pickup time and location.
Help.aFree: Yes, FoodShare is completely free to use. We believe in building community through sharing.
Help.qEditListing: How do I edit or delete my listing?
Help.aEditListing: Go to your profile and find the listing under "My Listings". Tap the menu icon to edit details or mark as collected/delete.
Help.aCommunityFridges: Community fridges are public refrigerators where anyone can leave or take food. They appear on the map with a special icon. Check their hours and guidelines before visiting.
Help.qSettings: How do I change my settings?
Help.aSettings: Go to Settings from your profile menu. You can update your email, password, notification preferences, and privacy settings.
Help.aLocation: Your exact location is never shared. Listings show an approximate area. You control what location details to share when coordinating pickup.
Help.qDeleteAccount: How do I delete my account?
Help.aDeleteAccount: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This will permanently remove your profile, listings, and messages.
Help.tipDoubt: When in doubt, don't share it
Help.legacyNote: Migrated from legacy docs — now part of the web:
Help.cantFind: Can't find what you're looking for? Send us feedback through your <accountSettings>account settings</accountSettings>. We typically respond within 24-48 hours.
Help.alsoReview: You can also review our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

Privacy.meta_description: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1_intro: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
Privacy.s1_messages: Messages sent through our chat feature
Privacy.s2_intro: We use the information we collect to:
Privacy.s2_service: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
Privacy.s2_notify: Send notifications about your listings and messages
Privacy.s2_respond: Respond to your comments and questions
Privacy.s2_abuse: Detect and prevent fraud and abuse
Privacy.s3_intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
Privacy.s3_users: With other users as necessary to facilitate food sharing
Privacy.s3_providers: With service providers who assist in operating our platform
Privacy.s3_legal: When required by law or to protect rights and safety
Privacy.s4_body: FoodShare uses location data to show nearby food listings on the map and connect you with local sharers. You can control location sharing through your device settings. Your exact location is not shared with other users unless you choose to include it in your listings.
Privacy.s5_body: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Privacy.s6_access: Access and update your personal information
Privacy.s6_delete: Delete your account and associated data
Privacy.s6_copy: Request a copy of your data
Privacy.s7_body: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your session, remember your preferences, and improve your experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
Privacy.s8_body: FoodShare is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us.
Privacy.s9_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the “Last updated” date.
Privacy.s10_body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the feedback form in your account settings.

Terms.meta_description: Read our terms and conditions for using the platform.
Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.s1_body: By accessing and using FoodShare, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provisions of this agreement. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our service.
Terms.s2_body: FoodShare is a community platform that connects people to share surplus food, reducing food waste and helping those in need. Users can list available food items, discover local offerings on an interactive map, and coordinate exchanges via real-time chat.
Terms.s3_intro: As a user of FoodShare, you agree to:
Terms.s3_accurate: provide accurate information about food items you share
Terms.s3_safe: ensure all shared food is safe for consumption
Terms.s3_purpose: use the platform only for its intended purpose
Terms.s3_lawful: not engage in any fraudulent or harmful activities
Terms.s4_body: FoodShare is a platform for connecting food sharers and recipients. We do not guarantee the safety or quality of any food items shared through our platform. Users are responsible for ensuring food safety and making informed decisions about accepting shared food.
Terms.privacy_link: Your privacy is important to us. Please review our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> to understand how we collect, use, and protect your information.
Terms.s6_body: FoodShare is provided “as is” without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use of our platform, including but not limited to issues related to food quality, safety, or user interactions.
Terms.s7_body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of FoodShare after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
Terms.s8_body: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us through the feedback form in your account settings.
